notes: Presets live in the Lights library: save, apply, update, rename, delete
Palettes in alphabetical order with favourites, and a palette editor for custom palettes
Solid colour is its own mode; effects are chosen from a dropdown with filters
Firmware updates from Settings, with release notes
Devices page: all controllers on the network, their versions, updates, presets and effects; copy presets (with their scripts) between devices
